name: QBrain Accessibility
author: QBrain LTD

sections.description:
QBrain Accessibility adds a modern accessibility toolbar to WordPress.

This plugin is fully functional and is not a trial.

Features:
* Branded QBrain logo
* Full toolbar visible without scrolling on desktop
* Text size increase and decrease
* Readable font mode
* High contrast mode
* Dark contrast mode
* Grayscale mode that does not hide the toolbar
* Link highlighting
* Heading highlighting
* Form field highlighting
* Text spacing
* Pause animations, transitions, marquees and active videos
* Hide images and videos
* Reading guide
* Real oversized custom cursor
* Keyboard focus mode
* Reset all preferences
* LocalStorage preference saving
* Admin settings page
* Custom toolbar position: top, middle or bottom; left or right
* Custom primary color
* Accessibility statement link
* Choose opening button style: icon + text, icon only, or text only
* Visitor language auto-detection
* Built-in interface translations: Hebrew, English, Arabic, Russian, French and Spanish
* Compact or wide panel layout
* Optional QBrain logo display
* Optional browser preference saving

Important: This plugin improves accessibility experience but does not guarantee full WCAG compliance by itself. Full compliance requires site audit, semantic HTML, keyboard testing, contrast review, content review and ongoing maintenance.

Asset Licensing

  • assets/qbrain-logo.png is owned by QBrain Innovation LTD.
  • assets/qbrain-logo.png is distributed under GPLv2-or-later as part of this plugin package.
sections.installation:
1. WordPress Admin > Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  2. Upload the ZIP.
  3. Activate.
  4. Go to Settings > QBrain Accessibility.
sections.changelog:
2.0.9

Resolved Plugin Check escaping findings in toolbar output and reduced readme tags to five.

2.0.8

Clarified the Settings API sanitizer callback used by register_setting().

2.0.7

Removed manual text domain loading for WordPress.org modern translation handling.

2.0.6

Updated WordPress.org tested version metadata and aligned the plugin text domain with the public slug.

2.0.5

Updated WordPress.org submission metadata, licensing information and public plugin naming.

2.0.4

Cleaned up PHP formatting for WordPress Coding Standards readiness without changing behavior.

2.0.3

Moved frontend JavaScript toolbar dictionaries into WordPress-localized script data.

2.0.2

Prepared PHP-rendered admin and toolbar strings for translation and loaded the plugin text domain.

2.0.1

Hardened settings registration, admin capability checks and internal SVG escaping for WordPress.org readiness.

2.0.0

Added multilingual visitor UI, language auto-detection, compact/wide layout, logo toggle and preference-saving toggle.

1.0.3

Added admin options for toolbar position and button display style.

1.0.2

Added real oversized custom mouse cursor.

1.0.1

Fixed grayscale hiding toolbar, improved pause animations, added QBrain logo, compact no-scroll desktop layout.

1.0.0

Initial release.
